c2av-syriac-smoke.description: Smoke test: 1 c2av plate (17 lines), train=val=holdout. Validates fine-tuning from sophro_mhiro_syriac.safetensors with --augment and --resize new on real c2av data. Pipeline check only, not model quality.

metadata.notes: Smoke test for fine-tuning pipeline with augmentation. 1 epoch, --quit fixed, --augment. Expected cost: ~$0.02 on RTX 3090.
